name: Crypto Watchlist
description: A compact USD market snapshot for Bitcoin, Ethereum, and Solana.
template:
<Stack gap='sm'>
  <Group justify='space-between' wrap='nowrap' gap='xs'>
    <Stack gap={0} style={{ minWidth: 0 }}>
      <Text fw={700} truncate>Crypto watchlist</Text>
      <Text size='xs' c='dimmed'>USD · Quotes update on refresh</Text>
    </Stack>
    <RefreshButton requestId='q' />
  </Group>
  {status.q?.loading ? <Skeleton height={210} /> : status.q?.ok === false ? <Alert color='red' title='Market data unavailable'>{status.q.statusText || status.q.error || 'Request failed'}</Alert> : (data.q?.data ?? []).length === 0 ? <Text size='sm' c='dimmed'>No market data available</Text> : <Stack gap='sm'>{(data.q?.data ?? []).map(asset => <Stack key={asset.id} gap={4}>
    <Group justify='space-between' wrap='nowrap' gap='xs'>
      <Stack gap={0} style={{ minWidth: 0 }}>
        <Text size='sm' fw={600} truncate>{asset.name ?? 'Unknown'}</Text>
        <Text size='xs' c='dimmed'>{asset.symbol ?? '—'}</Text>
      </Stack>
      <Stack gap={2} align='flex-end'>
        <Text fz={20} fw={700} truncate>{asset.quote?.[0]?.price?.toLocaleString('en-US', { style: 'currency', currency: 'USD', maximumFractionDigits: 2 }) ?? '—'}</Text>
        <Badge color={(asset.quote?.[0]?.percent_change_24h ?? 0) > 0 ? 'green' : (asset.quote?.[0]?.percent_change_24h ?? 0) < 0 ? 'red' : 'gray'} variant='light'>{asset.quote?.[0]?.percent_change_24h?.toLocaleString('en-US', { maximumFractionDigits: 2, signDisplay: 'always' }) ?? '—'}{asset.quote?.[0]?.percent_change_24h === undefined ? '' : '%'}</Badge>
      </Stack>
    </Group>
    <SimpleGrid minColWidth={140} autoFlow='auto-fit' spacing='xs'>
      <Group justify='space-between' wrap='nowrap' gap='xs'><Text size='xs' c='dimmed'>Market cap</Text><Text size='xs' fw={600} truncate>{asset.quote?.[0]?.market_cap?.toLocaleString('en-US', { style: 'currency', currency: 'USD', notation: 'compact', maximumFractionDigits: 1 }) ?? '—'}</Text></Group>
      <Group justify='space-between' wrap='nowrap' gap='xs'><Text size='xs' c='dimmed'>24h volume</Text><Text size='xs' fw={600} truncate>{asset.quote?.[0]?.volume_24h?.toLocaleString('en-US', { style: 'currency', currency: 'USD', notation: 'compact', maximumFractionDigits: 1 }) ?? '—'}</Text></Group>
    </SimpleGrid>
    <Text size='xs' c='dimmed'>Updated {asset.last_updated ? Date.toLocaleString(asset.last_updated, 'en-US', 'UTC') : '—'} UTC</Text>
  </Stack>)}</Stack>}
</Stack>
